note: Pinned with v1's hashes (E0 card Amendment 1): the same exposed r3 index of e0-r3/run-5, the same stage brief, source ids, chunk count and extraction budget, so v1 and its run record stay as they are. The conditions are the serving card's plan call: legacy-thinking-structured (the strict research_plan response_format item 9 sends, thinking on, 8,192 tokens) and the same call at 16,384 tokens, legacy-thinking-structured-16384, a calibration cell a card cannot send until P10 measures plan at 16,384. legacy-thinking, the plan call without a card, is the control within the run. 10 repeats, 30 calls. Proposed by BL-20261116-1253-e0-planner-structured-condition-design; the E0 card's amendment names the command before the run. The command line takes these conditions and repeats from the manifest.
